en.title: Know what is pending, who is responsible and where the evidence is.
en.description: CumpliDatos is TempoLegal’s platform for organizing data protection tasks and following up on work with your organization.
steps: Identify tasks, responsible people and dates.
Review what is missing and coordinate each area’s actions.
Keep together the records and documents supporting the work.
en.limit: It supports your team and the DPO. It does not replace professional judgment or your organization’s responsibilities, and does not by itself guarantee legal compliance.
en.dpdLead: Independent advice and supervision to support the management of your data protection obligations.

en.faq: CumpliDatos is TempoLegal’s own platform for organizing tasks, tracking progress and gathering evidence of the work. It is included at no additional cost while you retain TempoLegal’s DPO service. It supports the DPO’s professional judgment; it does not replace implementation or guarantee compliance.
